payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance results related to the effectiveness of oversampling in improving model performance for detecting cyberbullying.

claims.text: Oversampled datasets (F+, T+, W+) show significantly better performance compared to their non-oversampled counterparts (F, T, W).
All models exhibited bias towards labeling posts as non-bullying due to class imbalance in the training datasets.
Deep learning models can effectively address the challenges of class imbalance and improve detection performance.
